Introduction

YunSeo is a South Korean singer, rapper, and dancer under BPM Entertainment. She is best known as a member of the girl group BADVILLAIN. On May 16, 2024, YunSeo was revealed as the seventh and last member of BADVILLAIN. The group officially debuted on June 3, 2024, with their debut single album "OVERSTEP".

Prior to debuting, she was a contestant on the survival show My Teenage Girl.
